name: es31-texture-gather
title: textureGather and textureGatherOffset
summary: textureGather on 2D, 2D array and cube textures: every component selection, the texel order of figure 8.7, wrap modes at the edges, textureGatherOffset up to the queried MIN/MAX_PROGRAM_TEXTURE_GATHER_OFFSET, shadow samplers (comparison results), integer samplers, swizzle, incomplete textures and the compile-time constant rules; every result compared exactly with a CPU model on textures whose texels are all distinct.
spec: ES 3.2 §8.14.2 Coordinate Wrapping and Texel Selection (the gather rules, figure 8.7, table 8.21 wrap(), textureGatherOffset limits, incomplete textures)
ES 3.2 §8.13 Cube Map Texture Selection (table 8.20), §8.13.1 Seamless Cube Map Filtering
ES 3.2 §8.17 Texture Completeness, §8.20.1 Depth Texture Comparison Mode (table 8.22), §8.10 Texture Parameters (swizzle, wrap, filters)
ES 3.2 chapter 21 Implementation Dependent Values (MIN/MAX_PROGRAM_TEXTURE_GATHER_OFFSET, MIN/MAX_PROGRAM_TEXEL_OFFSET)
ES 3.2 §8.5 Texture Image Specification, §8.18 Immutable-Format Texture Images
GLSL ES 3.10 §8.9.3 Texture Gather Functions, §8.9.2 Texel Lookup Functions (textureOffset: constant offsets), §4.7.4 Default Precision Qualifiers
GLSL ES 3.20 §8.9.4 Texture Gather Functions (textureGatherOffsets, non-constant offsets), used only on an ES 3.2 context

api.glGenTextures: nine source textures and three result targets
api.glBindTexture: 2D, 2D array, cube map textures bound to unit 0 for every gather
api.glTexStorage2D: immutable RGBA8, RGBA8I, RGBA32UI, DEPTH_COMPONENT16 and cube map images: gathered back texel by texel
api.glTexStorage3D: RGBA8 and DEPTH_COMPONENT16 2D array images with three layers
api.glTexSubImage2D: 8 x 8 RGBA8 / RGBA8I (BYTE) / RGBA32UI (UNSIGNED_INT) / depth (UNSIGNED_SHORT) uploads and the six cube faces: every gathered value equals the uploaded texel
api.glTexSubImage3D: array layers uploaded one at a time: gathers of layers 0, 1, 2 equal the uploaded layers
api.glTexImage2D: a mutable texture with only level 0 and the default NEAREST_MIPMAP_LINEAR filter is incomplete: it gathers (0, 0, 0, 1)
api.glTexParameteri: TEXTURE_WRAP_S/T (CLAMP_TO_EDGE, REPEAT, MIRRORED_REPEAT), MIN/MAG_FILTER (ignored by gather), TEXTURE_SWIZZLE_R/G/B/A (applied before the component is selected, incl. ZERO and ONE), TEXTURE_COMPARE_MODE/FUNC (shadow results change with the function): each changes the gathered image exactly as the CPU model predicts
api.glGetIntegerv: MIN/MAX_PROGRAM_TEXTURE_GATHER_OFFSET and MIN/MAX_PROGRAM_TEXEL_OFFSET: the relations of section 8.14.2; the queried extremes are then used as constant offsets
api.glCompileShader: a non-constant comp argument and a non-constant textureGatherOffset offset are rejected by the GLSL ES 3.10 compiler; the constant forms compile
api.glUseProgram: one program per shader variant (component, offset, sampler type)
api.glGetUniformLocation: u_tex, u_size, u_layer, u_ref located; their effects are visible in the gathered images
api.glUniform1i: sampler unit and the array layer / cube face; layer coordinates 7 and -3 are clamped to the last and the first layer
api.glUniform1f: u_size (texel scale) and the shadow reference depth
api.glDrawArrays: one full-viewport triangle per gather, each fragment one footprint query
api.glGenFramebuffers: RGBA8, RGBA32I and RGBA32UI result framebuffers
api.glBindFramebuffer: results rendered into single-sample targets, window as the draw framebuffer of the blits
api.glFramebufferTexture2D: the result textures attached as color 0
api.glClearBufferfv: sentinel (0.3, 0.6, 0.9, 0.5) before every float gather: a draw that wrote nothing would fail the exact comparison
api.glClearBufferiv: sentinel -7777 / 7777 before every signed integer gather
api.glClearBufferuiv: sentinel 0xDEADBEEF before every unsigned integer gather
api.glReadPixels: RGBA/UNSIGNED_BYTE for float results, RGBA_INTEGER/INT and RGBA_INTEGER/UNSIGNED_INT for integer results: compared exactly with the CPU model
api.glBlitFramebuffer: sixteen result images stretched NEAREST into the window cells; every block read back and compared with the model
api.glViewport: the gather region (9 x 9 footprints, or 7 x 7 for cube maps) selected per draw
api.glClear: window background and the alpha-only clear (color mask) that makes the window opaque
api.glColorMask: alpha-only mask: the clear writes alpha 1 and leaves the blitted colors untouched (verified by the window check)
api.glDisable: DITHER disabled so that 8-bit results are exact

visual_review.notes: 256x256 radeonsi es-max capture viewed (llvmpipe and zink captures are byte-identical to it). A 4x4 grid of 64x64 cells separated by a thin dark margin, every cell filled by a 9x9 block image (7x7 for the cube cell), nothing empty and no stray pixels. Rows 1-3 (CLAMP_TO_EDGE, REPEAT, MIRRORED_REPEAT) x comp 0..3 are smooth ramp gradients in different directions and tints (beige/olive, blue-violet, olive with a magenta edge strip, white/yellow with blue and green edges) that differ between comps and show distinct seam strips along the edges where the footprints wrap; the CLAMP cells differ from the REPEAT and MIRROR cells only in the outermost rows and columns. Last row: the array-layer cell (olive gradient with a blue strip on one edge), the cube-face cell (olive gradient), the shadow gather as a 9x9 mosaic of black, white, red, green, blue, cyan, magenta and yellow blocks (every channel 0 or 1, as expected), and the offset (2,-3) cell as a gradient shifted by whole blocks.
